olivia: Quick heads-up  platform wants SDKs to surface a machine-readable routing/quota error so Console can show a direct recovery path instead of fuzzy "unknown" tiles. Draft shape and rollout plan below.

mark: Can you paste the example payload? console needs a stable code.

olivia: Example (returned only when client sends X-RW-RouteErrors: v2): ```json {"code":"ROUTE_POLICY_VIOLATION","policy":"quota:bulk-embeddings","allowed":0,"requested":1,"hint":"upgrade-plan","meta":{"tenant":"org-77"} } ``` SDKs should expose a typed error with those fields.

sunita: TS SDK: adding RoutePolicyError subclass is straightforward. We'll add a constructor flag `routeErrorsV2: 'auto'|'on'|'off'` and env var `RW_ROUTE_ERRORS_V2`. Effort ~0.5d + docs. We'll not remap the HTTP status.

andre: Py SDK: same approach. Ensure compatibility so `except RedwoodAPIError` still catches new error. We'll parse legacy 400 text as fallback. Add migration note and tests.

mark: Telemetry/Console: emit event `routing.policy_reject` with fields: code, policy, tenant_hash, sdk, frontend. Console will surface counts, top policies, and resolution links when hint.url present. Keep sampling low for privacy.

olivia: Rollout plan: server feature-flagged; header opt-in returns 409+structured JSON. SDKs ship opt-in. Console flips header for beta orgs and canary (5%). After validating telemetry and UX, flip internal defaults then public default with 2-week notice. No Retry-After header on these errors.

sunita: Will target a patch release with opt-in and README example. Tag PR with `sdk:route-errors-v2`.

andre: I'll add unit tests for v2 and legacy shapes. No auto-retries in SDK.

deploy-bot: deploy: feature/route-errors-v2 -> canary started (5% traffic). build ci-9077. :rocket:

olivia: Thanks all  post PR links here and I'll coordinate the console mock + telemetry mapping.
